Maria (PM): Quick sync — Legal wants contract language for an auto-migrate path from embeddings-v1 -> embeddings-v2. We need product acceptance gates, rollback SLAs, and billing impact notes. Who can draft?
Sam W: I can take a first pass on the acceptance gates. Proposal: precision delta <= 1% on our benchmark suite + no latency regress >5ms at p99 for the typical request mix.
Raj K: Add opt-out window + forced opt-in timeline. Ops needs an opt-in flag and a customer canary cohort (start at 5%). Also clarify whether this applies to Hosted only or Dedicated/Private too.
Olivia D: Important: embeddings can change dim (e.g., 1536 -> 2048). We should include a server-side compatibility shim: pad/truncate vectors and add a metadata tag `v2-converted` so downstream tooling knows.
Olivia D: Example shim snippet: `def pad_to_dim(vec, d=2048): return vec + [0.0]*(d-len(vec)) if len(vec)<d else vec[:d]`
Maria (PM): Thinking a 3-phase rollout: canary 5% -> cohort 25% -> global 100%, with 2-week holds between phases and automated quality checks at each gate.
Sam W: Rollback gates: trigger rollback if any of these occur during a phase: precision delta >1.5% on top-10 benchmarks, p99 latency increase >10ms, or >2% increase in customer error reports for affected routes.
Raj K: For SLA on rollback, ops asks for an expected RTO. Proposal: Hosted: rollback within 4 hours. Dedicated/Private: different constraints — Private might need longer for air-gapped sites.
eng-platform-bot: deploy-bot: Created canary job canary-emb-swap-172999 (manual trigger). See /ops/jobs/canary-emb-swap-172999
Olivia D: Confirmed — Private deployments likely need 24h window for rollback commits. We'll note that in the contract appendix as an exception.
Maria (PM): OK accept exception. Action items: Sam: draft acceptance + rollback doc. Raj: spec opt-out UX + billing clause. Olivia: prototype shim and add bench tests. Can we aim to have drafts by Friday?
Sam W: I’ll have the acceptance + rollback doc by Thu EOD and include example evaluation queries.
Raj K: I’ll draft the opt-out contract language and a sample clause for migration credits for Dedicated customers. Will post here when ready.
Olivia D: :thumbsup: I’ll wire up the shim in a feature branch and add it to nightly bench runs; will report results in this thread.
Maria (PM): Thanks — tagging @legal for visibility and @sales to flag customer comms. We’ll reconvene after drafts.
